subject: expression: introduce `SafeToShareAcrossSession` to `Expression` for Instance Plan Cache (#57110)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent limited to `pkg/expression/`. Change introduces `Expression.SafeToShareAcrossSession()` and generated per-builtin implementations: signatures with only `baseBuiltinFunc`/`baseBuiltinCastFunc` are considered shareable iff all args are shareable (result cached via an atomic flag); others always return false. No non-expression callers exist at this commit. Checked later history up to `upstream/master`; the only High-risk candidate noticed (Constant mutating internal state during eval/stringification, relevant when sharing expressions across sessions) was fixed later (commit `80b34784bf`), leaving no remaining Blocker/High issues.
